messages:
maria: Quick async check — where do we stand on the token-cost attribution + latency breakdown work? Need a short status for the cross-team sync tomorrow. Who owns the rollout milestones and what infra deps are still blocking?

alex: Owner for end-to-end is me. Main milestones: 1) schema finished + signoff (this week), 2) ingestion + cost calc prototype (next week), 3) canary query dashboard + alerts (2 weeks).

sam: Blocking deps: eng-runtime needs to expose KV cache hit/miss metrics and per-request seq_len distribution. I put a draft ticket in eng-runtime backlog. cc @alex for prioritization.

jordan: Schema PR open: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/42 — the event fields and naming are in the diff. Please review for telemetry conventions.

liz: Quick question on allocation logic: are we doing per-request marginal token cost (tokens * per-token-rate) or amortized (batch-level) attribution? This affects the final numbers in the dashboard.

alex: good call. Plan: compute per-request marginal token_cost_usd = tokens_generated * model_unit_price, plus a per-request share of batch overhead. We’ll include both fields: `token_cost_usd` and `amortized_overhead_usd` so consumers can pick.

maria: Nice. Can you add a short doc snippet for the README so BizOps knows how to interpret?

alex: will do. Draft snippet I’ll push to the PR before EOD.

jordan: FYI schema preview (from PR):
```json
{
  "event_type": "inference.request",
  "time": "2025-12-01T18:23:00Z",
  "request_id": "req_01F...",
  "model": "redwood-v2.1.q4_8bit",
  "model_revision": "r2025-11-30",
  "client_tier": "hosted",
  "seq_len": 128,
  "tokens_generated": 64,
  "latency_ms": 132.4,
  "kv_cache_hit": false,
  "batch_size": 6,
  "token_cost_usd": 0.0032,
  "amortized_overhead_usd": 0.0009
}
```

liz: That looks good. One more: sampling frequency for high-volume routes? We don't want every single request for cost reasons. Proposal: full events for requests >500ms or tokens_generated>300, 1% sampling for everything else, top-ups for suspicious outliers. Thoughts?

sam: Agree on sampling. Runtime can tag `sampled:true` and include `sampling_rate` so we can scale counts. Need to coordinate on exact telemetry tag names.

alex: I'll add `sampled` and `sampling_rate` to the schema in the next commit.

platform-bot: CI: instrumentation/pr-42 — schema lint passed; e2e tests queued (ETA ~14m). :white_check_mark:

maria: For the sync tomorrow: please paste the PR link, list of open infra tickets, and the canary dashboard query (or a screenshot). If someone can volunteer to run the canary on Thurs that would be great.

jordan: PR link again: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/42 — reviewers: @alex, @liz, @sam. Open infra tickets: ENG-RUNTIME-881 (KV cache metrics), ENG-METRICS-309 (aggregation pipeline tuning).

liz: I can run the canary Thurs AM and monitor cost delta.

alex: thanks — I’ll queue the rollout checklist here: 
- schema signoff (owners: alex/jordan)
- runtime metric exposure (owner: sam)
- ingestion consumer + sampler (owner: alex)
- dashboard + alerts (owner: maria)
- BizOps README + interpretation (owner: alex)

maria: Perfect. Last ask: please add any breaking naming changes to the PR description so we can update downstream consumers (billing pipeline, quality-monitoring).

sam: noted. I’ll sync naming with runtime team tomorrow morning.

alex: pinging reviewers for the PR — quick review would unblock signoff: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/42 :pray:

jordan: reviewing now, should be done in ~2h.

maria: Thanks all — this thread is enough for the sync deck. If anything urgent pops up, update here or @maria directly. :rocket:
